# Game8

> > Game8 is a comprehensive gaming resource hub providing walkthroughs, guides, reviews, and wikis for popular games across multiple platforms.

Game8 aggregates gaming content from Japan and worldwide, covering major titles like Genshin Impact, Pokemon, Monster Hunter, and Crimson Desert. The platform serves both casual and hardcore gamers with detailed character builds, tier lists, quest guides, and gacha banner information.

## Key Topics

- Walkthroughs & Guides
- Game Reviews
- Character Builds
- Tier Lists
- Gacha Banners
- Quest Guides
- Mobile Games
- Open World
- First Impressions
- Gaming News
- Genshin Impact
- Pokemon Series
- Monster Hunter
- PlayStation 5
- Cross-Platform Gaming

## Game Wikis & Walkthroughs

- [Genshin Impact Walkthrough & Guides Wiki](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact): Comprehensive Genshin Impact wiki with character builds, tier lists, and gacha banners.
- [Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection Walkthrough & Guides](https://game8.co/games/Monster-Hunter-Stories-3): Monster Hunter Stories 3 wiki with monster lists, quests, and gear guides.
- [Crimson Desert Walkthrough & Guides Wiki](https://game8.co/games/Crimson-Desert): Crimson Desert wiki with quests, maps, builds, and weapon guides.
- [The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin Walkthrough & Guides Wiki](https://game8.co/games/The-Seven-Deadly-Sins-Origin): 7DSO wiki featuring tier lists, character builds, and team compositions.
- [Pokemon Pokopia Walkthrough & Guides Wiki](https://game8.co/games/Pokemon-Pokopia): Pokemon Pokopia wiki with habitat building, crafting, and Pokemon guides.
- [Pokemon Champions Walkthrough & Guides Wiki](https://game8.co/games/Pokemon-Champions): Pokemon Champions wiki with battle mechanics and cross-platform roster info.
- [Pokemon Winds and Waves Walkthrough & Guides Wiki](https://game8.co/games/Pokemon-Winds-Waves): Pokemon Winds and Waves Gen 10 wiki with starters and release information.
- [Umamusume: Pretty Derby Walkthrough & Guides Wiki](https://game8.co/games/Umamusume-Pretty-Derby): Umamusume wiki with character database, support cards, and racing guides.

- [Elder Scrolls 6 Director Wants Fans to Pretend It Doesn't Exist](https://game8.co/articles/latest/elder-scrolls-6-director-wants-fans-to-pretend-it-doesnt-exist): Todd Howard discusses Elder Scrolls 6 announcement timing and development strategy.
- [Subnautica 2 Early Access Release Confirmed in May](https://game8.co/articles/latest/subnautica-2-early-access-release-confirmed-in-may-amidst-legal-dispute): Subnautica 2 May early access release with Unknown Worlds leadership changes.
